universities.restrictions: MIT requires prior written authorization before an outside organization uses its logo or seal (https://brand.mit.edu/contact; https://policies.mit.edu/policies-procedures/120-relations-public-use-mit-name-and-facilities-use/123-use-institute-name). No authorization was requested.
universities.notes: Reviewed in batch 2 and not used. File:MIT_logo.svg is the 2003–2023 wordmark (Matthew Carter for MIT, about 2002), vectorized from the MIT website. Its only copyright tag is PD-textlogo. The 2006 upload was described as fair use, which does not match a public-domain claim. File:Massachusetts Institute of Technology logo.svg is a conversion of an official graphic-identity ZIP. No historical seal with a public-domain record that matches its date was found. The 1915 bookplates on Commons are unofficial modified forms and were not used. Do not retry these wordmarks unless MIT grants permission.

universities.name: University of Pennsylvania
universities.license: Public domain. The PNG is extracted from the scan of Thomas Harrison Montgomery, A History of the University of Pennsylvania from Its Foundation to A.D. 1770 (George W. universities.attribution: Thomas Harrison Montgomery, A History of the University of Pennsylvania (1900), via Wikimedia Commons. Attribution is not required.
universities.restrictions: This is the historical seal printed in that 1900 history (legend SIGILLUM ACADEMIAE PHILADELPHIENSIS, motto SINE MORIBUS VANAE, date MDCCL), not Penn's current shield. Used only to identify the University of Pennsylvania. The 2008 Inkscape redraw and the archives coat of arms tagged CC0 were not used.
universities.notes: Upload URL: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/a/a8/University_of_Pennsylvania_seal_%28from_History_of_the_Univ_of_PA_1900%29.png. File:University of Pennsylvania seal 1894.svg is a 2008 drawing tagged PD-US, which does not match that date. File:University of Pennsylvania, Coat of Arms.svg is taken from the Penn archives and tagged CC0 by the uploader, not by Penn.
